scope: TH14 ECL 326 RGB interpolation: 1224 timelines compare actual 42db70 setup and 473af0/473df0 dynamics for all 32 modes plus default -1/32, four duration cases, three rates and three RGB targets. Tangents are cleared, alpha is preserved, each Hermite product is truncated separately, RGB bytes wrap as in retail. TH14 ECL 325/327/331/336 color, alpha and layer setters: 320 native cases with slot bounds, missing handles, byte truncation, unchanged other channels and flags. ECL 328/332 primary/secondary alpha interpolation: 2448 timelines compare actual setters 42d9b0/42d900 and 473af0/474190 dynamics for all 32 modes plus default -1/32, negative/zero/one/35-frame durations, three rates and three start/target pairs; primary tangent clearing, secondary tangent preservation and blend-mode switch agree. Integer output is converted once after rounded SSE operations. TH14 ECL 330 scale interpolation: 816 timelines compare actual 42dd70 setup and 473af0/474750 dynamics and actual easing 4041a0 / sine 4a8020 against production ANM updates, all 32 retail modes and two default cases (-1, 32), negative/zero/one/35-frame durations, three rates and two targets; timer/start/end/tangents and scale bits agree. TH14 ECL 329/335 scale and scale-velocity setters (160 cases, slot bounds/stale handles, reverse argument read order and dirty flags), ECL 315 angled effect creation (189 cases, three resources, first ANM update before position/angle overwrite, signed zero/NaN/infinity), ECL 319 slot-local rotation, flags and stale-handle clearing; ECL 303/306/307/308/313/316/318 creation/replacement, base-script selection/restoration, flags, sixteen slots, layer/origin and first ANM update; sixteen-slot position synchronization, native direction changes and ECL 554 stage-logo guard/creation. Argument reads, allocation, resource binding and registry lookup are controlled boundaries. Complete resource template caching and alternate-mode frontend wiring are not covered. ECL 320 is the retail per-slot animation offset setter at 4253c0; X/Y raw float values and forced-zero Z agree, including sentinels, NaN and infinity. Tests traverse the production ECL route; the native argument readers are boundaries. ECL 337 at 425581: 189 actual handler/ANM first-update comparisons, XYZ position plus offsets and rotation installed before first update, including rotation overwritten by the script, signed zero, NaN and infinity; reverse argument read order [3,2,4,1,0]. Resource binding and allocation remain controlled boundaries.
